from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
org='organization-35e007ca'
base=datetime.now(timezone.utc)-timedelta(minutes=10)
def ts(dt): return dt.isoformat().replace('+00:00','Z')
print('BEGIN;')
now=ts(base)
for i in (1,2):
    print(f\"INSERT INTO workers (id, organization_id, status, capabilities_json, enrolled_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('s6-worker-{i}', '{org}', 'online', '[]', '{now}', '{now}', '{now}');\")

    print(f\"INSERT INTO pm_tasks (id, project_id, title, description, status, assignee, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('s6-task-{i}', 's6-project-{i}', 'S6 Task {i}', '', 'running', 'agent:s6-agent-{i}', 'user:s6', '{now}', '{now}');\")
execs=[('a',1,'succeeded',10,1000),('b',1,'failed',20,2000),('c',2,'succeeded',30,3000),('d',2,'failed',110,4000)]
for idx,(suffix,agent,outcome,wait_ms,dur_ms) in enumerate(execs):
    queued=base+timedelta(seconds=idx*10)
    started=queued+timedelta(milliseconds=wait_ms)
    finished=started+timedelta(milliseconds=dur_ms)
    wid=f's6-worker-{agent}'; aid=f's6-agent-{agent}'; tid=f's6-task-{agent}'; eid=f's6-exec-{suffix}'
    print(f\"INSERT INTO worker_control_events (id, worker_id, \\\"offset\\\", idempotency_key, command_type, payload, agent_id, task_id, status, execution_id, status_updated_at, created_at) VALUES ('s6-cmd-{suffix}', '{wid}', {idx+1}, 's6-idem-{suffix}', 'agent.fork_executor', '{{}}', '{aid}', '{tid}', 'started', '{eid}', '{ts(started)}', '{ts(queued)}');\")
    print(f\"INSERT INTO agent_activity_events (id, agent_id, task_ref, interaction_ref, event_type, payload, occurred_at) VALUES ('s6-start-{suffix}', '{aid}', '{tid}', 'executor:{eid}', 'lifecycle', '{{\\\"event\\\":\\\"executor.start\\\",\\\"executor_id\\\":\\\"{eid}\\\",\\\"cli\\\":\\\"codex\\\",\\\"model\\\":\\\"gpt-5\\\"}}', '{ts(started)}');\")
    reason=',\\\"reason\\\":\\\"s6-failure\\\"' if outcome=='failed' else ''
    print(f\"INSERT INTO agent_activity_events (id, agent_id, task_ref, interaction_ref, event_type, payload, occurred_at) VALUES ('s6-stop-{suffix}', '{aid}', '{tid}', 'executor:{eid}', 'lifecycle', '{{\\\"event\\\":\\\"executor.stop\\\",\\\"executor_id\\\":\\\"{eid}\\\",\\\"outcome\\\":\\\"{outcome}\\\"{reason}}}', '{ts(finished)}');\")
# Slot observations: each agent has one running slot for one minute then idle/closed, producing known non-null utilization and coverage.
for agent in (1,2):
    obs1=base+timedelta(minutes=1, seconds=agent)
    obs2=obs1+timedelta(minutes=1)
    snap1='{ \"admission_cap\": 1, \"slots\": [ { \"slot_index\": 0, \"state\": \"running\", \"executor_id\": \"s6-exec-a\", \"task_id\": \"s6-task-%d\" } ] }' % agent
